steps.text: Sorry, I'm late. I was busy today.

steps.name: Tired Female Voice
steps.text: Mercia, please...

steps.name: Tired Female Voice
steps.text: I must... remember...

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Your situation is unusual.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Your memories are like wilted leaves hanging from withered branches. Wiping away the dust might restore some sheen, but if you press too hard, you'll only damage them further.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: By all rights, I should not even touch them. If not for...

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Sorry, Madam Væla.

steps.name: Væla
steps.text: I must... know. I must... remember.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Your memories since leaving your homeland have not been happy ones. However, if you insist... close your eyes, and we'll try again.
Mercia puts her old projector on the table with some effort.
Her fingers glide as glass slides drop into the slot, and the aging Banshee becomes covered in an unfamiliar scene.

steps.name: Væla
steps.text: I remember... this place.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Leithanien?

steps.name: Væla
steps.text: She... mentioned it.

steps.name: Væla
steps.text: The spire... shackles... blood.
Slowly, indistinct memories begin to diffuse on the backdrop cast by the projector. Mercia can identify an elderly figure shackled by the wall, as robed figures come and go.
The smell of blood, a terrifying melody, the marks of Arts.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: A Leithanian spire. Were you imprisoned there... as a test subject?

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: You would have been buried beneath the tomes of the spire casters, if not for the aid of a Lich.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: The Ecclesia Requietum in the Holy City. You were in the funeral procession? For kindred who have wandered afar... or the foe of your clan?

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: But the angels didn't like it, did they? They want laughter at their funerals... not wailing.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: You were almost arrested by the Pontifica Cohors.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: You came to Columbia... through the frontiers? Even... the Bleached Wasteland?

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: The wind-blasted land which not even beasts dare to tread?

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: And finally... you came here.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Why Propeller Paradise in particular? What did you come looking for...?

steps.name: Væla
steps.text: Here... there is a tree here.

steps.name: Væla
steps.text: The tree here is wilting... decaying.

steps.name: Væla
steps.text: Wilting, decaying.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: I see.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: We have a Vivarium here, and a terrible accident just happened in it—wilt and decay, as you say.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: The master of the Vivarium...

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: She's a Banshee too.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Do you know this thing?
The bone pen that caused the disaster at the Vivarium, which was later confiscated by Gordon Tannen, now lies in Mercia's hand, white and innocent.

steps.name: Væla
steps.text: ...Her.

steps.name: Væla
steps.text: I sense... her presence.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: You came to look for someone.

steps.name: Væla
steps.text: I want... I want to see her.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: No need to crouch so low, Oakley. The Arts unit on your back is slipping.

steps.name: Oakley
steps.text: This is Rhine Lab's underground passage. The walls could have nano-monitors listening to us!

steps.name: Oakley
steps.text: Besides, we have to worry about Propeller Paradise's warning system too... why do we have to avoid the police, if we're doing this for Tannen?

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Do you think he trusts many of his subordinates?

steps.name: Oakley
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Even the elevator guard could be a pair of eyes for some big shot. If anything goes wrong, the trouble could go way further than just a few boxes of contraband.

steps.name: Oakley
steps.text: So the two of us, being outsiders with no such interests in this, ended up being the best choice to 'dispose of' his stuff?

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: But there is something I haven't been able to figure out.

steps.name: Oakley
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: You got someone to do your job, and you got someone to meet them on the other side. Why not just lie down in your office, pet your finbeast, and put on some jazz?

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Aren't you worried about getting yourself in trouble if you're on the scene—sir?

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: I came to see my little darlings off!

steps.name: Oakley
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Quit fidgeting! You almost hit the wall with the Arts recreation unit! I told you to treat it nicely, like your life depends on it!

steps.name: Oakley
steps.text: Yeah, I remember.

steps.name: Oakley
steps.text: You'd better remember what you said too, if we deliver your darlings safely and keep our mouths shut—

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Then we're square.

steps.name: Oakley
steps.text: Great!

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Don't let your guard down. Nasti has refused to leave the Vivarium. She's continuing her research in the middle of a roomful of failures, pulling all-nighters.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: So she's right above us? I think I hear her footsteps...

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Don't worry, Mercia will take care of her.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Merry? Merry!

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: ...Yes, Mr. Tannen, I hear you.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: What's going on there? If something goes wrong, you've GOT to keep Nasti distracted, whatever it takes.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Don't worry, sir.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: It was my negligence that allowed the accidents to happen...

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: I'll keep a close eye on Director Lunorey and ensure she leaves the Rhine Vivarium, buying as much time for you as possible.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Very good.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: See? Even Merry steps up her game when it matters most.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: You two had better do the same. We're almost at the exit.

steps.name: Oakley
steps.text: Yessir.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Ferne has a keen sense of hearing.
There is a risk that you will be exposed. Do you need the Emergency Management Council to intervene?

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: There are better ways to use the Maylander name. No need to worry about me; being Mr. Tannen's secretary makes an excellent cover.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Report.

steps.name: Maylander Agent
steps.text: Bravo's intel is that the Rhine technical staff have evacuated the experiment zone. Director Lunorey and her aide are the only ones who currently access this site. However...

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: She spends an inexplicable amount of time here.

steps.name: Maylander Agent
steps.text: ...Yes.

steps.name: Maylander Agent
steps.text: Apologies are in order. As members of your squad, we should have trusted your judgment. It does seem that Rhine Lab might be hiding something under the exhibition hall.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: No need to apologize. My mission was to monitor the tech firms.

steps.name: Maylander Agent
steps.text: What about Director Lunorey, if we need to perform further investigation?

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: I have a plan. We'll have at least twenty minutes if everything goes well.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: I prepared a gift that she can't refuse.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Whoa!

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Again.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Is this the system that the Vivarium and floating botanical units run on?

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: I knew the Banshees were good at manipulating objects from a distance, but to abandon sound as the medium, sealing incantations inside the module and repairing flaws through self-cycling... this is a revolutionary innovation!

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: If it's all incantation-driven...

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: You should stop reading purely speculative papers.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Most people don't know much about the Banshees. I understand they rarely leave the valley of Convallis...

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Did you live there before coming to Columbia?

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: My first memories are of Kazdel. I was later adopted by one of my kin and taken to the Convallis.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: What kind of place is it?

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: A peaceful, beautiful place.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: The riverbanks are covered in grass and shrubs. The flowers never wilt and the fruit never falls. Not even rain disturbs its tranquility, much less Catastrophe.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Why did you leave, then?

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Who could it be, at this hour?

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: D-Director! Over here!

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Is this your bone pen?

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: ...Part of it.
The conical tip, severed from the rest of the pen, rolls across the floor.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Who could have done this...?

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: What happened in the Vivarium wasn't an accident, and it wasn't a practical joke. Everything was planned, and they were targeting someone... maybe the target was you, or maybe Rhine Lab itself.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: There is a way to find out.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: (In Sarkaz) Guide.
The fragment in Nasti's hand floats up into the air at her command, a white halo enveloping it. The pen tip spins a few times, then slowly flies off in a certain direction.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Looks like the other half of the pen isn't far away.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Director...

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: It could be a trap, yes. But I must go.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: I sense traces of a familiar incantation from the bone pen.
